newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Tuesday, pressured by private investors' profit-taking in reaction to Monday's rises, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.0 yen to 3.0 yen per kg lower. Benchmark February stood 1.0 yen down at 144.7 yen.
Activity was buoyant. The market started the day on a weaker note on profit-taking, after benchmark February had broken above the strong resistance of 145 yen per kg on Monday.
But prices recouped some of their early losses ahead of the close, in response to the yen's weakness against the dollar, they said.
